image_description: An underwater scene featuring three Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor) swimming near a coral reef. The primary subject is a large fish on the right, displaying the characteristic black anterior and yellow posterior coloration. Two smaller conspecifics are visible in the mid-ground to the left. The background consists of blue water and rocky/coral structures.
